newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia MBF Unit Trust launches stock index fund.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia MBF Unit Trust launches stock index fund.

text.p: MBF Holdings Bhd's MBf Unit Trust Bhd said it launched a stock fund that tracks the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's benchmark Composite Index.

In a statement issued late on Thursday, MBf Unit Trust said its MBf Equity Index Fund aims to "produce stable investment returns similar to or better than the KL Composite Index average return over the medium and long term."
The Composite Index is comprised of Malaysia's top 100 blue chips.

MBf Unit said at least two-thirds of the fund will be invested in the Composite Index at all times, with the balance, if any, put into "an enhanced equity portfolio of other growth stocks including foreign securities."
It noted that the Composite Index has registered average gains of 17 percent a year from 1987 to 1996, with the index chalking up an average rise of 20 percent a year from 1991 to 1996 alone.
During the launch period of the fund, MBf Unit Management Bhd is offering investors a special price of 1.00 ringgit per unit until June 21, 1997, the statement said.
After that date, "investors will have to buy at the manager's prevailing selling price based on the market value of investments in the fund," it said.
